## Appearance

Isolde Pembroke is a small, extremely lovely young girl with a lively vigor and complexion marked by rosy cheeks. She has black, shiny raven hair and dark eyes.

## Personality

Isolde Pembroke is a sweet, kind, and good individual whose cheerful demeanor and speech readily bring laughter and smiles to others. Characterized as an exceptionally comforting companion, she privately harbors a constant fear of being a dumpling. She is also skilled in crafting red tissue paper bookmarkers, a technique known to very few girls at her school.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P29](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0029), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. ## History

Isolde Pembroke received her name from a schoolmaster lodging at her home when she was born, and she later learned a decorative crochet stitch while visiting her aunt in [Delford](../codex/places.md#delford). At [Pear Hill](../codex/places.md#pear-hill), she met [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), and the two young girls quickly swore to be best friends forever. Though Isolde's mother ordered her to break off the friendship, leading to an emotional farewell, Isolde continued to exchange secret notes with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) at [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) school. When her baby sister, [Posy Fay](../character/posy-fay.md), contracted croup while their parents were away, Isolde rushed to [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) to seek help from [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), who successfully treated the child. Isolde later hosted a party where [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) broke her ankle, and her family gave [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) slippers for [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) that year.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Obed Abernethy Is Surprised P64](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0064), [v1 CHAPTER VIII. ## Quotes

> "I am so happy that you have moved to Grey Shutters. Having a companion to play with will be wonderful. No other girls reside close enough for us to play together, and none of my sisters are old enough."
>
> — Isolde Pembroke — [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027)

> "Nell, you are an unusual girl. I had previously been told that you were unusual. Even so, it seems to me that I am going to be very fond of you."
>
> — Isolde Pembroke — [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P37](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0037)

> “Yes,” Isolde replied, jerking her head back, “however, it is my belief that Julia Bell is not favored by him to such a high degree. I have listened to him state that he used her freckles to learn the multiplication table.”
>
> — Isolde Pembroke — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P19](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0019)

> "Really, he teases every single girl. He makes jokes about mine on account of it being so black. He has named me a crow twelve times; and prior to this, I also have not known him to offer an apology for anything."
>
> — Isolde Pembroke — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P53](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0053)

> "I really believe you are unkind. What am I to do? Mr. Pidgeon is going to force me to be seated next to that dreadful Tibby Tulk—I am certain he will since no one is sitting beside her. Please return, Nell."
>
> — Isolde Pembroke — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P74](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0074)

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/isolde-pembroke--nell-harcourt.md)

Isolde and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) met at [Pear Hill](../codex/places.md#pear-hill) and quickly became close friends, walking to school together and spending time by the Nymph's Well. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) is a devoted companion to Isolde, even growing so deeply attached that she worries tearfully over the thought of Isolde marrying and leaving her someday. Their bond is further strengthened when [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) stays up all night at Isolde's home to save Isolde's baby sister from croup, and when [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) attends a party hosted by Isolde.
